title: Thousands Visit PLA Barracks in Hong Kong to Mark 29th Handover Anniversary
detail: Thousands of visitors attended open-day events at People's Liberation Army barracks in Hong Kong to celebrate the 29th anniversary of the city's handover from British to Chinese rule on July 1, 1997. The ceremonies, organized ahead of the formal July 1 anniversary, reflect ongoing efforts to deepen public engagement with the PLA garrison and reinforce Hong Kong's identity as part of China under the 'One Country, Two Systems' framework.
